integrity: The proof uses an exact finite chain model. Seven embedded integral kernel vectors and a modulo-3 rank certificate determine the rank of the top boundary without numerical approximation.
scientific_limitations: Only the integral third homology of the unordered three-particle configuration space is claimed; lower homology, products, braid-group presentations, and other particle numbers are not determined.
title: Top homology of the three-particle Pappus configuration space
